config._note: A booking confirmation template is a CONFIG record — the reusable subject/HTML/plain-text layout the notification engine renders when a booking is confirmed, with branding (logo, accent, footer, sender) and computed validation previews (rendered subject/body, length + size + whitelist checks). Body leads with the editable template fields and their live previews; there is NO email leaf because this is template configuration, not a live mailbox. Notification triggers that select this template are listed as related, and the audit trail sits in a sidebar tab to evidence who changed customer-facing copy.

fields.label: Locale
fields.help: Template language (nl or en). The notification engine selects the locale matching the customer language preference at dispatch.

fields.label: Subject line
fields.help: Email subject. Supports {{customerName}}, {{bookingRef}}, {{bookingDate}}, {{bookingTime}}, {{bookingLocation}}, {{organizationName}}. Max 78 characters after variable substitution.

fields.label: HTML body
fields.help: Inline styles only. Whitelisted elements: div, p, h1-h6, a, img, table, ul, ol, li, br, span, strong, em.

fields.label: Plain-text body
fields.help: Plain-text fallback for email clients without HTML rendering.

fields.label: Logo URL
fields.help: CDN or document-store URI. Inline base64 not supported.

config._relatedListsExclude: 'Triggers using this template' NOT converted — removed rather than faked. It was declared under `relatedLists`, which is not a prop on any Cn page component (it lands in $attrs and renders nothing), so it has never rendered. It is also not expressible as a `relatedCollections` filter: BookingNotificationTrigger.templateOverrideSlug stores a template SLUG (schema example 'default-confirmation-nl'), but BookingConfirmationTemplate exposes no flat slug field — only `name` ('Default Booking Confirmation'), a different value. A slug lives at `@self.slug`, which `@object.<field>` cannot reach (flat payload fields only), and `@objectId` yields a UUID that nothing stores in that field. No PHP reads or writes templateOverrideSlug, so there is no writer to prove an alternative. Restoring it needs a flat slug/key field on the template schemas, or a `@self.slug` token in nextcloud-vue.

config._note: A booking reminder template is a CONFIG record: the reusable email layout the engine renders N hours before a booking (hoursBeforeBooking 1–720), with branding and computed validation previews. Body leads with the timing + template fields and their live previews; NO email leaf — this is template configuration, not a mailbox. Triggers that select this template are listed as related; audit trail in a sidebar tab.

fields.label: Hours before booking
fields.help: Hours before booking start to dispatch the reminder (1–720). Common values: 1, 2, 24, 48, 72.
